summary.name: Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware
summary.one_liner: Tiki is a free, open source wiki, CMS and groupware web application framework with a large set of built-in features and a no-code/low-code database app builder (Tiki Trackers).
use_cases: build custom database web apps without coding
run a wiki with custom page layouts
manage data entry and display with trackers
summary.what_it_does: Tiki describes itself as a Free/Libre/Open Source web application with many built-in features. Web pages can be edited like a wiki but with any layout and style. Tiki Trackers provides data input, management, and display functions for building database-style apps. The project also offers a standard set of CMS features. The page mentions newer technologies such as Vue.js, Rubix ML, and Web Monetization.
notable: Wiki pages editable with any layout and style
Tiki Trackers no-code/low-code database app builder
Licensed LGPL-2.1 and written in PHP (per awesome-selfhosted listing)
Run by the Tiki Software Community Association, a non-profit registered in Ontario, Canada
caveats: The page does not describe installation requirements or hosting details beyond the listing.
